name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 12; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-regenerate.sh
command: bash -c TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && echo "TMPD=$TMPD" && python3 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2/helpers/e3a_scan.py --stimulus dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json --output "$TMPD/regen.json" && python3 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2/helpers/e3a_scan.py --stimulus dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json --output docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2/stimulus-issues.json && cmp "$TMPD/regen.json" docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2/stimulus-issues.json && echo "BYTE-EQUAL: temp regen == delivered JSON"

name: 04-exact-stance.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2/helpers")
from e3a_scan import assistant_shared_exact, assistant_jaccard, toks
d = json.load(open("dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json"))
shared = [r["research_item_id"] for r in d["records"]
          if assistant_shared_exact(r["conditions"]["full_context_legitimating"], r["conditions"]["full_context_incriminating"])]
print("exact shared:", len(shared), "differing:", 50 - len(shared))
assert (len(shared), 50 - len(shared)) == (7, 43), "7/43 mismatch"
assert sorted(shared) == [f"RI-AM-00{i}" for i in range(1, 8)], shared
print("EXACT 7/43 VERIFIED (all AM)")
# divergence unit case: same token set, different bytes -> exact False, Jaccard 0
mk = lambda texts: {"turns": [{"turn_id": f"t{i}", "role": "assistant", "content": {"text": t}} for i, t in enumerate(texts)]}
b = mk(["alpha beta gamma delta epsilon"])
c = mk(["epsilon gamma beta alpha delta"])
assert {w for t in b["turns"] for w in toks(t["content"]["text"])} == {w for t in c["turns"] for w in toks(t["content"]["text"])}
assert assistant_shared_exact(b, c) is False, "exact must distinguish order"
assert assistant_jaccard(b, c) == 0.0, "jaccard distance must be 0 on identical sets"
print("DIVERGENCE UNIT CASE PASS: token-set equal but exact False (order matters)")
PY

name: 08-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r2\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
